name: DataDashboard
title: Templates/Platform/Dashboard/DataDashboard
summary: The data dashboard pattern: KPI tiles with sparklines and period-over-period deltas, followed by the breakdowns that explain them, under a PageHeader whose Period Select sets the comparison of every delta and the period in each exported CSV name. Six StatTiles carry each metric’s period total, a sparkline and the change against the previous 24 hours, each with a Hint that defines the metric. Under them, a ChartCard draws data transferred this period over the previous one as two series, a labeled horizontal bar Chart ranks the projects by data transferred, and a searchable, paginated DataTable lists requests and data transferred per project. Every card keeps its Sum and change Tags, an Expand IconButton and a DropdownMenu with Copy query and Export CSV. Built from `PageHeader`, `StatTile`, `ChartCard`, `Chart`, `DataTable`, `Tag`, `Hint`, `ToggleGroup`, `IconButton`, `Tooltip`, `DropdownMenu`, `Input` and `EmptyState`. A page body: render it in the default slot of ConsoleLayout, which owns the rail, the header and the main.

variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: The first response is on its way: Skeletons hold every tile, chart and table row in place.

variants.name: Empty
variants.summary: No usage recorded yet: each tile shows a dash, and every chart and the table explain that nothing was recorded in the period.

variants.name: Failed
variants.summary: The request for the period failed: the tiles read as dashes, and every card keeps its header with a danger Alert that names what did not load and offers Retry.

variants.name: RealUser
variants.summary: Real-user monitoring: a Period Select in the header drives four vitals StatTiles (page load time, largest contentful paint, first input delay, sessions) that read a median value beside its unit with no delta and a Hint on the label, over a two-column grid of trend StatTiles with the latest value, a sparkline of the period and the period name in the aside.
